# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

networks:
  media-net:
    driver: bridge

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:v3.40.3
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    networks:
      - media-net
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to container network for inter-service communication
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # SABnzbd
      - "8085:8085"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:5.1.4
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080
    volumes:
      - qbittorrent-config:/config
      - /data/torrents:/data/torrents
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:8080 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prowlarr - Indexer Manager (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:2.3.0
    container_name: prowlarr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - prowlarr-config:/config
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9696/ping || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # FlareSolverr - Cloudflare Bypass (via VPN, optional)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Healthcheck disabled: FlareSolverr doesn't have a /health endpoint
  flaresolverr:
    image: ghcr.io/flaresolverr/flaresolverr:v3.4.6
    container_name: flaresolverr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - LOG_HTML=false
      - CAPTCHA_SOLVER=none
      - TZ=America/New_York
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Sonarr - TV Show Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Sonarr's download client
  # settings to use container names (e.g., gluetun:8080 for qBittorrent)
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.16
    container_name: sonarr
    networks:
      - media-net
    ports:
      - "8989:8989"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sonarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:8989/ping || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Radarr - Movie Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Radarr's download client
  # settings to use container names (e.g., gluetun:8080 for qBittorrent)
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:6.0.4
    container_name: radarr
    networks:
      - media-net
    ports:
      - "7878:7878"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - radarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:7878/ping || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Lidarr - Music Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Lidarr's download client
  # settings to use container names (e.g., gluetun:8080 for qBittorrent)
  lidarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:3.1.0
    container_name: lidarr
    networks:
      - media-net
    ports:
      - "8686:8686"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - lidarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:8686/ping || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bazarr - Subtitle Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Bazarr's Sonarr/Radarr
  # settings to use container names (e.g., sonarr:8989, radarr:7878)
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:1.5.3
    container_name: bazarr
    networks:
      - media-net
    ports:
      - "6767:6767"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - bazarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:6767/ping || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # SABnzbd - Usenet Download Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  sabnzbd:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:4.5.5
    container_name: sabnzbd
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sabnzbd-config:/config
      - /data/usenet:/data/usenet
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:8085/api?mode=version || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Recyclarr - TRaSH Guides Sync
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: Update recyclarr.yml to use container names for Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr
  # (e.g., sonarr:8989, radarr:7878, lidarr:8686)
  # Healthcheck disabled: Recyclarr runs on cron schedule, not continuously
  recyclarr:
    image: ghcr.io/recyclarr/recyclarr:7.5.2
    container_name: recyclarr
    networks:
      - media-net
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - RECYCLARR_CREATE_CONFIG=true
    volumes:
      - ./recyclarr:/config
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-media-management
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  gluetun-data:
  qbittorrent-config:
  prowlarr-config:
  sonarr-config:
  radarr-config:
  lidarr-config:
  bazarr-config:
  sabnzbd-config:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/otelcol-contrib", "components"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-monitoring
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Jellyfin Media Server Stack
# Includes: Jellyfin, Jellyseerr, Jellystat + PostgreSQL

name: jellyfin

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Streaming Server
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:10.11.5
    container_name: jellyfin
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - jellyfin-config:/config
      - jellyfin-cache:/cache
      - /data/library:/data/library:ro
    # AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding (VA-API)
    group_add:
      - "44"   # video group for GPU access
      - "104"  # render group for GPU access
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
      - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 8192m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8096/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyseerr - Media Request Management (Overseerr fork for Jellyfin)
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:2.7.3
    container_name: jellyseerr
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
    ports:
      - "5055:5055"
    volumes:
      - jellyseerr-config:/app/config
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:5055/api/v1/status || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellystat - Statistics and Analytics for Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat:
    image: cyfershepard/jellystat:1.1.6
    container_name: jellystat
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_IP=jellystat-db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - JWT_SECRET=${JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET}
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - jellystat-data:/app/backend/backup-data
    depends_on:
      jellystat-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Jellystat
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: jellystat-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=jellystat
    volumes:
      - jellystat-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    shm_size: 128mb
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U jellystat"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-jellyfin
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  jellyfin-config:
  jellyfin-cache:
  jellyseerr-config:
  jellystat-data:
  jellystat-pgdata:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Server with Ad Blocking
  # ==========================================================================
  # Primary DNS server for the network. Uses Cloudflare DNS as upstream.
  # Provides ad blocking, DNS filtering, and local DNS rewrites.
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:v0.107.71
    container_name: adguard
    volumes:
      - ./adguard/work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./adguard/conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    ports:
      # DNS ports - bind to host IP for network-wide access
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      # Web UI (AdGuard listens on port 80 internally)
      - "3000:80/tcp"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflared - Cloudflare Tunnel
  # ==========================================================================
  # Exposes internal services to the internet via Cloudflare Tunnel.
  # No inbound ports required - outbound-only connection to Cloudflare.
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:2025.11.1
    container_name: cloudflared
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run
    environment:
      - TUNNEL_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN}
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "cloudflared", "version"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflare DDNS - Dynamic DNS Updater
  # ==========================================================================
  # Updates Cloudflare DNS records with the current public IP.
  # Useful for services that need direct IP access.
  cloudflare-ddns:
    image: favonia/cloudflare-ddns:1.15.1
    container_name: cloudflare-ddns
    environment:
      - CF_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      - DOMAINS=${CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS:-homelab.rambtech.dev}
      - PROXIED=false
      - IP6_PROVIDER=none
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: favonia/cloudflare-ddns is distroless with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-network-services
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  portainer_agent_data:

        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    shm_size: 128mb
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.4
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab
      - METRICS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Training data for better OCR (optional)
      - stirling-tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      # Custom configurations
      - stirling-configs:/configs
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:8080/ | grep -q 'Stirling' || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================

# Immich - Self-hosted photo and video management
# https://immich.app/docs/install/docker-compose
# Updated: 2025-12 based on official v1.123+ config

name: immich

services:
  immich-server:
    container_name: immich_server
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Hardware transcoding: VAAPI for AMD GPU
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    volumes:
      - ${UPLOAD_LOCATION}:/usr/src/app/upload
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    env_file:
      - .env
    ports:
      - 2283:2283
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  immich-machine-learning:
    container_name: immich_machine_learning
    # Using CPU image since AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150) needs ROCm 6.4.4+
    # Immich ROCm image only has 6.3.4
    # Change to :release-rocm if/when Immich updates ROCm version
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Uncomment below and change image tag to :release-rocm when ROCm 6.4.4+ is available
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    #   - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    # group_add:
    #   - video
    #   - render
    volumes:
      - model-cache:/cache
    env_file:
      - .env
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  redis:
    container_name: immich_redis
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: valkey-cli ping || exit 1
    restart: unless-stopped

  database:
    container_name: immich_postgres
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: '--data-checksums'
    volumes:
      - ${DB_DATA_LOCATION}:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    shm_size: 128mb
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: >-
        pg_isready --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}" || exit
        1; Chksum="$$(psql --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}"
        --tuples-only --no-align --command='SELECT COALESCE(SUM(googlechecksum(googlechecksum(tableoid,
        entity_id))), 0) FROM entity WHERE NOT is_external')"; Prev="$$(cat
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum 2>/dev/null || echo '')"; echo "$${Chksum}" >
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum; test "$${Prev}" = '' -o "$${Prev}" = "$${Chksum}"
      interval: 5m
      start_interval: 30s
      start_period: 5m
    command:
      [
        'postgres',
        '-c',
        'shared_preload_libraries=vchord.so,vectors.so',
        '-c',
        'search_path="$$user", public, vectors',
        '-c',
        'logging_collector=on',
        '-c',
        'max_wal_size=2GB',
        '-c',
        'shared_buffers=512MB',
        '-c',
        'wal_compression=on',
      ]
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-immich
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  model-cache:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # n8n - Workflow Automation
  # ==========================================================================
  n8n:
    container_name: n8n
    image: n8nio/n8n:2.1.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5678:5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_HOST=${N8N_HOST:-n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev}
      - N8N_PORT=5678
      - N8N_PROTOCOL=https
      - WEBHOOK_URL=https://${N8N_HOST:-n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev}/
      - GENERIC_TIMEZONE=America/Los_Angeles
      - TZ=America/Los_Angeles
    volumes:
      - n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:5678/healthz || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Secure container management
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-n8n
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  n8n_data:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Authelia - Centralized Authentication
# https://www.authelia.com/

name: authelia

services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:4.39.15
    container_name: authelia
    environment:
      TZ: America/New_York
      AUTHELIA_JWT_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/jwt_secret
      AUTHELIA_SESSION_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/session_secret
      AUTHELIA_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /secrets/storage_encryption_key
      # OIDC env vars - uncomment when enabling OIDC clients
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_HMAC_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/oidc_hmac_secret
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_ISSUER_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE: /secrets/oidc_private_key
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./authelia:/config:ro
      - ./secrets:/secrets:ro
      - authelia-data:/data
    depends_on:
      - redis
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9091/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: authelia-redis
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-authelia
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  authelia-data:
  redis-data:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

networks:
  media-net:
    driver: bridge

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:v3.40.3
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    networks:
      - media-net
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to container network for inter-service communication
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # SABnzbd
      - "8085:8085"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:5.1.4
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080
    volumes:
      - qbittorrent-config:/config
      - /data/torrents:/data/torrents
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:8080 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prowlarr - Indexer Manager (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:2.3.0
    container_name: prowlarr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - prowlarr-config:/config
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9696/ping || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # FlareSolverr - Cloudflare Bypass (via VPN, optional)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Healthcheck disabled: FlareSolverr doesn't have a /health endpoint
  flaresolverr:
    image: ghcr.io/flaresolverr/flaresolverr:v3.4.6
    container_name: flaresolverr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - LOG_HTML=false
      - CAPTCHA_SOLVER=none
      - TZ=America/New_York
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Sonarr - TV Show Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Sonarr's download client
  # settings to use container names (e.g., gluetun:8080 for qBittorrent)
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.16
    container_name: sonarr
    networks:
      - media-net
    ports:
      - "8989:8989"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000

    volumes:

      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Radarr - Movie Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Radarr's download client
  # settings to use container names (e.g., gluetun:8080 for qBittorrent)
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:6.0.4
    container_name: radarr
    networks:

    environment:

      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Lidarr - Music Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Lidarr's download client
  # settings to use container names (e.g., gluetun:8080 for qBittorrent)
  lidarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:3.1.0
    container_name: lidarr
    networks:
      - media-net
    ports:
      - "8686:8686"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - lidarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:

          cpus: '1.0'

          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:

      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bazarr - Subtitle Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Bazarr's Sonarr/Radarr
  # settings to use container names (e.g., sonarr:8989, radarr:7878)
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:1.5.3

    deploy:

      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # SABnzbd - Usenet Download Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================

    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:4.5.5

services:

  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro

      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'

          cpus: '0.25'

      test: ["CMD", "/otelcol-contrib", "components"]

      timeout: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:

    command:
